skill.summary: Established in 1837, Tiffany Co is a US luxury jewelry brand known for its blue box, iconic engagement rings, and global expansion under LVMH ownership.

latestVersion.changelog:
Tiffany & Co. skill released!

- 提供蒂芙尼品牌的历史时间线及关键里程碑
- 概述 LVMH 收购及全球化、高端化战略
- 拆解商业模式、收入结构及品牌护城河
- 展示 2023 年最新营收、门店数等核心数据
